name: Hero-like 4-Connectivity (H4T)
definition: A ray traversal method that uses a 2x2 cell test to determine the first cell the ray enters, ensuring 4-connectivity. It uses a stable sorting algorithm on t-values and axis identifiers to resolve ties.
summary: Hero-like 4-Connectivity is a ray traversal algorithm that guarantees strict 4-connectivity by using stable sorting to resolve boundary crossing ambiguities, eliminating diagonal jumps and normal inaccuracies.
